propositions: The .reconciler-* merge=ours gitattributes strip arm in init.py is permanently unreachable because the reconciler pass-lock moved to refs/reconciler/* and the store has already converged
The _RETIRED_GITATTRIBUTES_LINES constant and its strip arm (lines 600-616 in init.py) must be removed as operator-approved pre-1.0 breaking change #3
The gitattributes migration test and drift matrix tests must be updated to retarget from 'committed file carries retired line' to 'no committed .gitattributes' since the create arm still functions
The removal requires updates to docs/release-notes.md and CHANGELOG.md to record the pre-1.0 breaking change
